bibdata.title: Information technology – Abstract Syntax Notation One (ASN.1): Specification of basic notation
Information technology – Abstract Syntax Notation One (ASN.1): Specification of basic notation
bibdata.abstract: Recommendation ITU-T X.680 | ISO/IEC 8824-1 provides anotation called Abstract Syntax Notation One (ASN.1) for defining the syntax ofinformation data. It defines a number of simple data types and specifies anotation for referencing these types and for specifying values of these types.The ASN.1 notations can be applied whenever it is necessaryto define the abstract syntax of information without constraining in any wayhow the information is encoded for transmission.
